/repos/langgenius/dify/issues?state=all&.title: refactor(web): replace the legacy Mermaid renderer with Pele
/repos/langgenius/dify/issues?state=all&.body:
## Problem

Markdown Mermaid diagrams currently depend on a large feature-local Mermaid.js integration with separate rendering, theme, preview, and export behavior. We want to replace that implementation with Pele and align preview composition with the current Dify UI Dialog contracts.

## Expected behavior

- Render Mermaid code blocks using Pele, with application theme tokens and bounded parsing/output.
- Preserve the last valid drawing during incomplete updates and open a stable preview snapshot.
- Provide a full-screen, centered canvas with consistent zoom, keyboard interaction, image copy, SVG download, and opening the complete diagram in a new tab.
- Use Dify UI Dialog primitives for focus and overlay lifecycle, and remove the previous renderer and obsolete controls.

## Validation scope

Cover rendering, incomplete-input recovery, preview lifecycle, zoom geometry, accessibility, and export behavior through the public Markdown/diagram entrypoints. Verify the running development application and Storybook as well as automated tests.

/repos/langgenius/dify/issues?state=all&.title: Notion page search textbox has no explicit accessible name
/repos/langgenius/dify/issues?state=all&.body:
### Self Checks

- [x] I have searched for existing issues and pull requests for this problem.

### Dify version

main

### Steps to reproduce

Open the Notion page picker when importing knowledge, then inspect the search textbox's computed accessible name. The input has a localized placeholder but no label or ARIA naming relationship; its accessible name is empty. Typing also removes the visible placeholder.

### Expected behavior

The search textbox should have a persistent localized accessible name, including while a query is entered. Reuse the existing Search pages translation without changing the visual layout.

### Proposed fix

Add an explicit aria-label and extend the existing picker interaction test to locate the textbox by role and name before typing, after typing, and after clearing.

A bound key returns `403` for any other dataset — both documents and retrieval — and for endpoints that carry no dataset ID, such as list-all. /repos/langgenius/dify/releases?per_page.body:
## 🚀 What's New in v1.14.2?

v1.14.2 is a patch release focused on security hardening, workflow and knowledge reliability, observability fixes, agent groundwork, and deployment/runtime tuning after v1.14.1.

### 🔐 Security and administration

- **Tenant-scoped sensitive endpoints** — strengthened tenant isolation for app trace-config endpoints and FilePreview text extraction. Thanks @xr843 in [#35793](https://github.com/langgenius/dify/pull/35793) and [#35797](https://github.com/langgenius/dify/pull/35797).
- **Tool credential safety** — restricted default builtin tool credential updates to workspace admins and owners, and cleaned stale tenant tool credentials during `reset-encrypt-key-pair`. Thanks @NeatGuyCoding and @xr843 in [#36264](https://github.com/langgenius/dify/pull/36264) and [#35843](https://github.com/langgenius/dify/pull/35843).

### 🧩 Workflow, HITL, and app runtime

- **Workflow execution reliability** — restored tracing after HITL workflow resume, improved workflow run callback tracking, reduced message-update database roundtrips, fixed memory fetches outside Flask context, and closed base64 file lookup sessions correctly. Thanks @Blackoutta, @CodingO

/repos/langgenius/dify/releases?per_page.body:
## 🚀 What's New in v1.14.1?

v1.14.1 is a patch release focused on security hardening, workflow and knowledge-base stability, deployment cleanup, and continued UI platform migration after v1.14.0.

### 🔐 Security

- **Self-hosted `SECRET_KEY` hardening** — Docker deployments no longer rely on a public default key. When `SECRET_KEY` is left empty, the API generates and persists a runtime key through the configured storage backend, while explicitly configured keys continue to work as before. Thanks @laipz8200 in [#36049](https://github.com/langgenius/dify/pull/36049).
- **Internal metrics endpoint protection** — `/threads` and `/db-pool-stat` are hardened to avoid unauthenticated exposure of internal runtime and database-pool details. Thanks @orbisai0security in [#35665](https://github.com/langgenius/dify/pull/35665).
- **Account and tool isolation** — fixed an IDOR issue in `GET /account/avatar` and scoped builtin-tool default-credential cleanup to the current tenant. Thanks @NeatGuyCoding and @GareArc in [#35771](https://github.com/langgenius/dify/pull/35771) and [#35887](https://github.com/langgenius/dify/pull/35887).
- **Dependency security** — upgraded LiteLLM for CVE

Our latest patch release, v1.13.3, focuses on stability and correctness across workflow execution, streaming, and knowledge retrieval. Here's a quick look at the most important updates:

### 🎬 New Features
- **Workflow Configuration**: Added variable-reference support for model parameters in LLM, Question Classifier, and Variable Extractor nodes by @scdeng in #33082.

### 🛠️ Bug Fixes
- **Streaming Reliability**: Fixed `StreamsBroadcastChannel` replay and concurrency issues to keep frontend/backend event delivery stable by @QuantumGhost in #34030 and #34061.

If an application uses an unavailable plugin, model, tool, knowledge base, or any other dependency that prevents it from functioning, the application should be marked Unavailable.

Support a Status filter with **Available**, *
